parts.text: (iv) On Tuesday, each person spends the same time listening to the news as they did on Monday. They each spend 5 minutes longer reading the news than they did on Monday. parts.label: b
parts.text: (b) In February Sancho read the news for a total of 8 hours. This was a reduction of 36% from January. Work out how long Sancho read the news in January. ........................................ hours [2]
